[Trait] HEROIC INSPIRATION: MONK When a friendly character attacks, if no Heroic Inspiration traits have been used this turn, you may replace a die in the attack with a [d:5].

property.name: Traits and Special Powers
property.value:
[Trait] BEAST MASTER'S COMPANION When Elf Ranger starts the game, generate a Wolf bystander. // At the end of your turn, if Elf Ranger is within 4 squares of their Wolf, you may place that Wolf adjacent to them.
[Trait] HEROIC INSPIRATION: RANGER At the beginning of your turn, if no Heroic Inspiration traits have been used this turn, Elf Ranger may generate up to three hindering terrain markers within range. Until your next turn, opposing characters occupying or adjacent to these markers can't use [im:] abilities and must break away to move.
[Attack] ANIMAL HANDLING Powers: Precision Strike Precision Strike. // RANGE: Make up to two range attacks. If Wolf is within range, one of these attacks may instead be a close attack made by Wolf.

property.name: Traits and Special Powers
property.value:
[Trait] GAZE OF TWO MINDS At the beginning of your turn, you may choose another friendly character within 3 squares of Halfling Warlock. Until your next turn, as long as that character is within 3 squares of Halfling Warlock, Halfling Warlock can count range and draw line of fire from that character.
[Trait] HEROIC INSPIRATION: WARLOCK When an opposing character is hit, if no Heroic Inspiration traits have been used this turn, after resolutions you may deal that character 1 penetrating damage and give them an action.
[Defense] BEGUILING DEFENSES Powers: Super Senses, Invulnerability Super Senses. // Invulnerability, but only the first time Halfling Warlock is hit each turn.

property.name: Traits and Special Powers
property.value:
[Trait] BLESSED STRIKES Increase the damage Gnome Cleric deals to adjacent opposing characters by +1. // Adjacent friendly characters have SAFEGUARD: Pulse Wave and their powers and abilities have Protected: Pulse Wave.
[Trait] HEROIC INSPIRATION: CLERIC At the end of your turn, if no Heroic Inspiration traits have been used this turn, you may heal up to three friendly characters 1 click.
[Defense] SHIELD OF FAITH Powers: Energy Shield Deflection, Toughness Energy Shield/Deflection, Toughness. // Adjacent friendly characters can use Energy Shield/Deflection.

property.name: Traits and Special Powers
property.value: EFFECT: When a friendly character would roll a single d6, you may instead roll 2d6 and keep the higher result. (Choose either if there's a tie.)

[Defense] DARK DEVOTION Powers: Super Senses Super Senses. When Cultist uses it, increase the result of the d6 roll by +1 if the character they chose for Loyal Follower is on the map.
